title: Best of Both Worlds: Multimodal Contrastive Learning With Tabular and Imaging Data

layout.note: Three numbered, titled columns side by side, separated by two black dashed vertical lines that stop above the latent blobs. Column 1 is about half the width and holds two parallel branches (images left, table right) that share the row labels Encoders and Projectors; columns 2 and 3 are narrow copies with one image branch and a one-column table. Each column is read top-down and ends with a latent-space blob.

lesson: Run one minimal pipeline once per contribution and change a single input at a time, then repaint the changed input's colours onto the latent-space blob to show its effect; keep one colour per sample from input to embedding.
